title: Train Your Mind
devotional: Your mind needs training just as much as your body does. Every day, your attention is being shaped by what you watch, read, listen to, remember, and repeatedly think about. Romans 12:2 reminds us that transformation involves the renewing of our minds. This means you should not simply wait for better thoughts to appear. You can intentionally fill your mind with what is true, good, and pleasing to God. When unhealthy thoughts become familiar, replacing them takes practice. Today, pay attention to what you are feeding your mind and begin choosing what strengthens your walk with God.
mind_check: What do you regularly watch, listen to, or think about that may be shaping your mind in an unhealthy direction?
body_move: Take a break from one source of unhealthy mental input today. Put the phone down, leave the screen, go for a walk, or spend time doing something productive.
spirit_move: Spend time reading Scripture slowly. Choose one verse that speaks to the area you are struggling with and return to it throughout the day.
way_out: When I notice my mind moving toward __________, I will redirect my attention toward __________.
prayer: Father, renew my mind and help me become aware of what I am allowing to shape my thoughts. Give me discipline over what I watch, listen to, and focus on. Help me replace unhealthy thoughts with what is true, pure, honorable, and pleasing to You. Teach me to think in a way that reflects Your Word. Amen.
action: Choose one source of unhealthy mental input that you can reduce today. Replace at least 15 minutes of it with Scripture, prayer, worship, reading, exercise, or another healthy activity.
